text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before we knew it, the summer training camp had come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Man, this year's summer camp really flew by in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It just goes to show how fruitful this summer training camp was for all of us!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure the 'Kikuka Sho' will be here
in the blink of an eye just like this, too."
choice_data_list: Let's keep going strict and hard with the time we have left!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer ends, and autumn arrives.
The autumn of the decisive battle, where the Kikuka Sho awaits—
